opportunities.name: Plan city trip (flight, hotel, activity) and save summary note
opportunities.description: For a destination and dates, search Google Flights, Booking.com hotel, and Viator activity, then record a trip summary note with prices.
steps: Open Google Flights, set origin Paris, enter destination and dates, search and pick cheapest flight
Open Booking.com, enter destination and dates, search and open top hotel
Open Viator, search the landmark tour for the destination, open top result and read price
Open notes app and create a note 'Trip <city> <dates>: flight..., hotel..., tour...'

instances.values: Rome Dec 3-7, easyJet 89, Room Roma Nazionale, Colosseum tour
Barcelona Jan 20-24, Vueling-Iberia 113, IBIS Budget Barcelona Center, Sagrada Familia tour

opportunities.name: Compare two PyPI packages and save note
opportunities.description: Search PyPI for two packages, open each project's repository to get version, date, stars and license, then write a comparison note.
steps: Open the project page and note version and date
Click the Repository/Source link and note stars and license
Add note 'A version date stars license vs B ...'

opportunities.name: Browser feature support lookup and reply email
opportunities.description: Look up a web feature's browser support on caniuse and MDN, then draft a reply email to a person with version and docs link.
steps: Search the feature on caniuse and read the supported version for the browser
Search the feature on MDN and open the docs page
Open mail compose, fill To, Subject 'Re: <feature> in <browser>', and body with version and docs URL
